market_pulse.note: About $58,944 at 1 AM ET Sunday, up 5.68% over 24 hours (CoinCodex); later Sunday morning it traded near $60,424, down about 12.5% for the week, after a Saturday low near $55,130 (crypto.news).
About $1,654 at 1 AM ET, up 6.08% over 24 hours (CoinCodex); near $1,702 later Sunday morning, down nearly 13% for the week after a low of $1,542.97 (crypto.news).
About $2.04 trillion, up 2.57% from $1.99 trillion, after briefly dropping below $2 trillion on Saturday for the first time in more than two years (CoinCodex; CryptoPotato).
About 58.2%, down 0.39 points, per CoinCodex; crypto.news put it near 58.5% Sunday morning (CoinCodex; crypto.news).

themes.title: Weekend rebound stalls near $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin recovered from Saturday's drop to about $55,130 and was holding near $60,000 Sunday, still well below the roughly $68,000 level where the latest slide began (crypto.news; Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: Broad relief rally
themes.summary: About 91% of tracked coins gained over 24 hours, though trading volume fell about 34% to $88.45 billion, a sign of thin weekend activity (CoinCodex).

themes.title: Heavy liquidations
themes.summary: About $2.4 billion to $2.67 billion of leveraged positions, mostly longs, were wiped out during Friday and Saturday's drop, per CoinGlass data (Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had about $1.25 billion of net outflows from Nov. 16 to Nov. 20, bringing November outflows to more than $3 billion (Ted Pillows; crypto.news).

themes.title: Stock selloff weighs
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell about 7.9% last week as the Nasdaq lost 10% and markets priced a likely December Fed rate increase (The Closing Print).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both rose about 6% over 24 hours to early Sunday but remain down roughly 12% to 13% for the week (CoinCodex; crypto.news).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Mixed Sunday morning: XRP near $0.92 (-1.1%), Solana near $70.29 (-0.5%), BNB near $545.66 (-3.4%) and Hyperliquid near $60.73 (-3.0%) (crypto.news).

categories.name: Small caps and privacy coins
categories.note: Venice Token (VVV) led gains, Monero rose about 3% to $477 and Pi Network rose about 3% to $0.053 after an all-time low near $0.047 (CoinCodex; crypto.news).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Strategy closed Friday at $77.80, down 9.7%, and Coinbase fell 6.3% to $101.97; both trade again Monday (Ted Pillows).

watch_list.why: Traders watch whether Bitcoin holds near $60,000 into Sunday's weekly close after breaking support near $57,700 and setting a weekend low near $55,130 (crypto.news).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), a large Bitcoin holder, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
October PCE inflation is due Wednesday, Nov. 25, ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision, and U.S. markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving (JournalArta; Admirals).

movers.name: Venice Token (VVV)
movers.note: Up about 23.8% over 24 hours to near $24.90, the top gainer in the top 200 as of 1 AM ET (CoinCodex).

movers.name: Convex Finance (CVX)
movers.note: Down about 5.0%, the biggest loser in the top 200 as of 1 AM ET (CoinCodex).
